content: {"summary":"Investigate the broken handshake on edge-gateway-03 by examining Envoy stats, the mounted certificate files, deployment restarts, OpenSSL verification results, and the client device clock.","likely_cause":"Possible missing intermediate in the edge certificate file or client device clock skew","confidence":"medium","claims":[{"text":"Check Envoy listener stats for ssl.handshake and ssl.connection_error drops","evidence_ids":["RB-025#1"],"quote":"`listener.<address>.ssl.connection_error` (TLS errors other than failed certificate verification) is worth watching"},{"text":"Verify the certificate files mounted in edge-gateway-03 for missing intermediate certificates","evidence_ids":["RB-025#3"],"quote":"`Intermediate missing from the file`"},{"text":"Confirm the edge-public-tls Secret was updated and the edge-gateway deployment was rolled out after changes","evidence_ids":["RB-025#0"],"quote":"Envoy reads those files when it starts, so a renewed Secret takes effect only after `kubectl -n platform rollout restart deploy/edge-gateway`"},{"text":"Run openssl s_client against edge-gateway-03 to see the verify result code (e.g., 21)","evidence_ids":["INC-0043#1"],"quote":"It ended in verify code 21, the code RB-025 attaches to an intermediate missing from the served file."},{"text":"Check the client device's clock for skew that could cause handshake rejection","evidence_ids":["INC-0082#0"],"quote":"the cause was the client's own device clock"}],"next_checks":["Collect listener.<address>.ssl.handshake and ssl.connection_error metrics from Envoy admin port","Inspect the edge-public-tls Secret files on edge-gateway-03 for correct certificate chain","Verify that edge-gateway pods were restarted after any Secret change","Execute openssl s_client against edge-gateway-03 and record verify code","Ask the customer to confirm their device clock is accurate"]}
